Insure that the other oil cooler is in service.

عزل مبرد الزيت من الجانبين الزيت و 
 الماء واستنزاف الزيت في برميل فارغ.

Dismantle the reversing bonnet of the cooler 
 and take it out.

Dismantle the bolts of flange connecting the 
 cooler shell with its base.

Dismantle the bolts of inlet and outlet oil

Tight the shells from its eye bolt and lift it 
 to an empty place.

Clean tubes by using a soft rod or water lance

Clean the surface of tubes to remove the greasy 
 oil and other impurities by using acid cleaning.

sections.text: حَشد

Insure that the area around the tubes bundle is 
 clean.

Lift the cooler shell and put it in its place 
 after putting the gasket between the shell flange and its base flange.

Tighten the shell flange bolts firmly according 
 to their tighten torque with a torque wrench.

For making hydro test to check for leak we 
 should performed the following steps:

Put a blind flange on the outlet or inlet 
 flange which ever is the higher.

Connect the discharge pipe of a hand pump to 
 the other flange of cooler.

Pressurized the cooler with clean water and 
 notice any leaks from the upper side of tubes.

Plug the cracked tubes from the upper side 
 first by using useful wooden plug.

قم بتفكيك شفة أنبوب التفريغ باليد 
 ضخ وتفكيك الحافة التي تربط القشرة بالقاعدة وغيرها 
 جانب الأنابيب المتشققة بقوة.

Put the cooler shell again in its place and 
 tighten its connecting flange with base.

Tighten the bolts of the inlet and outlet oil 
 flanges.

Tighten the reversing bonnet of the cooler 
 shell.

Put the cooler in operation and notice the 
 outlet temperature of oil and record it hourly.

rows:
Double "O" Ring Seal Protection
Permits tube bundle to expand and contract 
 without harmful strain or intermixing of shell and tube fluids.
"O" Rings retain compression, without 
 adjustment, 
 and are unaffected by vibration and temperature changes. 
 No danger of over-tightening. Telltale holes reveals any leakage.

To Replace "O" ring Packing
Remove bonnet or channel at floating tube 
 shell end.
Remove existing "O" Rings and "O" Ring 
 retainer
Clean sealing surface including OD Ring of 
 floating tube sheet.
Assemble inner (shell side) "O" Ring
تجميع حلقة التجنيب وتشديدها على الصدفة 
 شفة باستخدام البراغي التي يتم ربطها في الحلقة.
Assemble outer (tube side) "O" Ring.
Replace floating head bonnet or channel.
